title: Completion-to-Closing Gap — Builder Extended Rate Lock Extension Days
content:
The space between the estimated completion of the home and the scheduled closing on the Home Purchase Agreement is measured when a Builder Extended Rate Lock is extended.

**Rule.** The completion gap is the calendar days from the purchase agreement's estimated completion date to its scheduled closing date. A gap of 7 days or fewer adds 2 days to the days to cover; a gap above 7 days up to 14 days adds 1 day; a longer gap adds none. The days are added before the days to cover are rounded up to whole increments.

| Completion gap | Days added |
|---|---|
| 7 days or fewer (a closing on or before the estimated completion date included) | 2 |
| 8 to 14 days | 1 |
| 15 days or more | 0 |

Both dates are read from the Home Purchase Agreement record of the agreement the lock finances.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Estimated completion | Scheduled closing | Gap | Days added |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 September | 8 September | 7 | 2 |
| 1 September | 9 September | 8 | 1 |
| 1 September | 15 September | 14 | 1 |
| 1 September | 16 September | 15 | 0 |
